title: Yield Curve Prediction with Machine Learning Replication Spec
hypothesis: Macro-augmented direct-yield and factor-based forecasts vs random walk
sample: Full yield surface 1986-05 to 2025-06. In-sample 1986-05 to 2014-12 fixed rolling window. Out-of-sample evaluation 2015-01 to 2025-05. Validation 2010-01 to 2014-12. Key maturities {3,6,12,18,24,36,60,120,240,360} + slopes 24_120,24_360,60_360. Macro panel 123 series x lags 4-6 = 369 predictors. T_h1=125 T_h3=123 T_h6=120 T_h12=114
method: 1. Construct yields: use FilipovicPelgerYe2024 zero-coupon month-end yields for 10 key maturities 3,6,12,18,24,36,60,120,240,360 months; define slopes 24_120=y120-y24 etc. Summary stats 1986-05 to 2025-06 Table yield_summary.
2. Macro: take FRED-MD 123 series Table macro_vars_full, apply FRED-MD transform codes 1-7, impose uniform 3-month publication lag, use lags 4-6 (369 predictors).

3. Direct-yield approach: target Dh y_t(tau)=y_{t+h}(tau)-y_t(tau) equation direct_forecast_delta, predictor vector x_t, estimate f_h(tau)(x_t) direct_forecast_delta_hat, reconstruct y_{t+h|t}=y_t+ Dh_hat equations direct_forecast_delta_reconstruct.

4. Factor-based approach: DNS equation dns with lambda>0 and DNSS equation dnss with lambda1,lambda2>0. Baseline lambda=0.0609 DNS, lambda1=0.0609 lambda2=0.01 DNSS. Extract beta_t by OLS each date conditional on lambda. Forecast factors h-step direct: beta_{t+h|t}=Phi_h(I_t) equation beta_forecast_generic. Baseline AR(1) own lag beta_{i,t-1} in levels. RF variant target Dh beta_{i,t}=beta_{i,t+h}-beta_{i,t} equations beta_diff_target beta_rf_diff_forecast beta_diff_reconstruct with information set {beta_{t-l}, y_{t-l}, x_{t-j}} lags yields/factors 1-6, macro 4-6.

5. Time-varying decay: estimate lambda1t,lambda2t month-by-month by hybrid PSO + L-BFGS-B: minimize sum_j (y_t(tau_j)-hat y_t(tau_j;theta_t))^2 subject to lambda1>=lambda2>=0 baseline, plus beta0>=0 beta0+beta1>=0 ZLB variant. theta=(beta0,beta1,beta2,beta3,lambda1,lambda2). Swarm 300 particles, 1000 max PSO iter, stall tol 1e-8, inertia w linear w_start to w_end, c1,c2 ring topology init 10% swarm increasing radius, velocity v_i^{k+1}=w_k v_i^k +c1 r1(p_i-x_i)+c2 r2(n_i-x_i), x_i^{k+1}=x_i^k+v_i^{k+1}. Init one particle at t-1 optimum + anchor lambda1=0.0609 lambda2=0.01 OLS betas. Search domain lambda in [1e-9,0.4] beta in [-1,1]. L-BFGS-B on top 10 particles 500 max iter ftol 1e-12 gtol 1e-8 box constraints. In-sample betas from OLS conditional on PSO lambdas, out-of-sample lambdas random walk hat lambda_{t+h|t}=lambda_t equation lambda_random_walk, yields OLS reconstruction.

6. RF: 500 trees min leaf 5, mtry selected by recursive CV on validation 2010-01 to 2014-12 final 60 targets candidate m in {sqrt(P),P/10,P/6,P/4,P/3,P/2,2P/3} rounded lowest validation RMSE Table chosen_mtry_all_models. P=90 Direct-RF,460 Direct-RF-X,108 DNS-RF,477 DNS-RF-X,114 DNSS-RF,483 DNSS-RF-X,114 DNSS-RF-PSO,483 DNSS-RF-PSO-X. Impurity importance I_j = sum_{s in S_j} N_s/N (Q_s - N_{s,L}/N_s Q_{s,L} - N_{s,R}/N_s Q_{s,R}) forest average rescaled to 100.

7. Evaluation: fixed-size rolling window in-sample 1986-05 to 2014-12 out-of-sample 2015-01 to 2025-05 horizons h=1,3,6,12. RMSE_h = sqrt(1/T_h sum (y_{t+h}-hat y_{t+h|t})^2) Relative RMSE = RMSE_comp / RMSE_RW <1 beats RW. DM test: d_t = L(e1)-L(e2) squared loss, bar d =1/T sum d_t, DM=bar d / sigma_bar sigma_bar=sqrt(S_d(0)/T) HAC S_d(0) lag largest <= floor(T^{1/3}) significant 5% Bartlett else 0 Table hac_sig_lags. Stars ***1% **5% *10% Tables rrmse_h1 h3 h6 h12 armse.
8. Fit: date RMSE_t = sqrt(1/M sum (y_t(tau_m)-hat y_t(tau_m))^2) average over 1986-05 to 2025-06 Table factor_fit_rmse.

9. Trading: synthetic zero-coupon price P_t(tau) R_total=(P_{t+h}(tau-h)-P_t(tau))/P_t(tau) R_roll=(P_t(tau-h)-P_t(tau))/P_t(tau) R_curve=R_total-R_roll. Duration trades 24,120,360 months: w_model=-Delta hat y / sigma_Delta, w_rolldown=R_roll/sigma_roll, w_tsmom=M_t/sigma_M M_t=sum_{j=1}^{12} r_excess_{t-j}. Slope trades 24-120,24-360,60-360 DV01-neutral: s_model=Delta hat S / sigma_DeltaS, s_rolldown=R_roll_steep/sigma, hedge w_b0=1 w_a0=DV01_b/DV01_a w_a=s w_a0 w_b=-s w_b0. Vol scaling from 2y in-sample signals, capped [-1,1], tc 1bp one-way. Annualized returns, ranks, 1st/top3, Sharpe, hit rate Tables duration/slope_summary_total_return curve_return slope_table_24_120_h1.
